fields.label: To Bench
fields.description: The bench here. Built first if it does not exist.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Planned
Running
Paused
Success
Failed
Cancelled

fields.label: On Action
fields.description: Which action in the list is running. A migration that stopped can be continued from here rather than restarted.

fields.label: Actions
fields.description: The ordered list, decided once when the migration is created. Each entry becomes an ordinary job, so each shows in the dock and in its own log.

fields.label: Move Files Too
fields.description: Public and private files as well as the database. Off means a much faster move that loses every attachment.

fields.label: Back Up Before Replacing
fields.description: Only applies to sites that already exist here and would be overwritten. A new site has nothing to back up.

fields.label: Database Root Password
fields.description: Needed to create each site and to restore into it. Held for the length of the migration and cleared when it ends, however it ends.
